note: Items no script can judge. The launch check lists them for the tester to answer. Keep each item one observable check.

funnel.text: Favicon, logo, product name and product images are the right product on every page, sharp on desktop and mobile.
Customer service phone number and email are correct and the same on every page.
Reviews, testimonials and side tickers name this product and brand, not a template's.
FAQ and claims are proofread and match what the merchant approved.
Package prices, discounts and currency match the offer plan on presell, landing, checkout and every upsell.
Exit pop-up shows the right packages, currency signs and discount; the coupon price is what the order records.
Warranty, protection or shipping-insurance add-on shows the right price for the package chosen.
Every call-to-action leads to the intended next page, and a scrolling or sticky call-to-action is present where the design has one.
Each upsell shows the right product and price, and accept and decline both lead where they should.
A test order was placed on every checkout option (each package or bundle), and the store's orders page shows the right products, options and prices for each.
'Shipping same as billing' shows and hides the billing fields correctly.
Address autocomplete suggests and fills addresses.
A checkout with the phone field left blank goes through (or the form marks phone as required, matching the store setting).
An invalid or expired card and a wrong CVV show a clear error, in the shopper's language.
Location-based content (currency, reviews, shipping countries) is right for each market sold to; check with a VPN for multi-country offers.
In the recorded order request or the store's order detail: the right campaign, shipping method and language code (a two-letter language code such as EN, not a country).
In your tag manager's preview mode, the purchase and upsell events fire once each with the right value and currency.
If you entered through an affiliate test link, the test conversion was rejected in the affiliate platform afterwards.
Checked on a real phone, and in Safari and Firefox (the automated run uses Chromium only).

storefront.text: Each menu item (for example Home, Shop, Support, Contact) opens the right page.
A real product search returns relevant results; a misspelling still finds it or suggests it.
Registering a test account and logging in with it works; a wrong password shows a clear error.
Cart shows the right name, price, quantity and subtotal; changing quantity recalculates; checkout starts from the cart.
Product page sections or tabs (overview, features, specs, reviews) open and show the right product.
The store is clear to navigate and messages are helpful on desktop, tablet and phone.
Checked in Safari and Firefox and on a real phone.

design.text: Side by side with the design: layout, spacing and imagery match at desktop width.
Side by side with the design: the mobile layout matches.
Copy matches the design word for word, including prices and claims.
